mapper.select: SELECT kb.id AS kb_id, kb.user_id AS kb_user_id, kb.name AS kb_name, kb.description AS kb_description, kb.create_at AS kb_create_at, kb.create_time AS kb_create_time, d.id AS document_id, d.title AS document_title, d.content AS document_content, d.base_id AS document_base_id, d.create_time AS document_create_time, CASE WHEN kb.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 'kb_name' WHEN d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 'document_title' WHEN d.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 'document_content' ELSE 'unknown' END AS matched_field FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN document d ON kb.id = d.base_id WHERE kb.user_id = #{userId} AND ( kb.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY kb.create_time DESC, matched_field ASC;
